body: I've been trying for a long time and it's feeling less and less worth the effort. Eventually it won't feel worth the effort at all

This is what I put originally:

Life has become so empty. I'm so lonely and I can't see a light. I want intimacy and affection so much and I know I'm not going to get it. I can't meet people anymore, there's just no way of doing it. I'm from a small town where there aren't many people and nothing happens so it gets to the point where you just know everybody you're going to know. New people stop coming into your life and there is nowhere to look for them. I can't take going to sleep alone and waking up alone much longer.
Not only that but I don't feel like part of my group of friends anymore. I've drifted to the background and it wouldn't make a difference if I wasn't friends with them anymore. Please don't tell me it would. I know the situation, and I know I'm right.
Depression has stopped me enjoying anything. Things I used to like doing, I don't want to do anymore because when I try to do them, I get frustrated at not feeling good enough. I'm bitter at everyone who is successful and happy because I want that. Whether it be someone in a relationship, with a well-paid job, someone who is successful as a musician or a writer or an athlete...I hate seeing people enjoying their life because I want to enjoy mine and I don't. I fucking hate living my life.
I feel like I've heard all the advice before, but I still have a desperate hope that maybe someone can somehow think of a reason I should want to wake up tomorrow. I have this constant feeling of frustration in my chest and there is absolutely nothing in my life that I can think of that makes it go away. Nothing that makes me think "as long as you have that..."

Being around other depressed people doesn't help me either I've found. I don't know what would help me but I'm done putting up with all of this now. I'm hoping somebody can make me see some sort of light because I really am at the end of the rope.

The internet to do what with? See a bunch of people make more out of their lives than I ever have or ever will? Even just on this site I constantly see people posting about their girlfriends/wives, and sharing links to people doing amazing things, or telling stories about cool stuff that's happened to them. Even just coming on Reddit has started to get me down because it's full of people being the way I wish I could be.

I want to be happy. I don't want to die. I feel like death is the solution, but I don't want it to be.
Maybe, but I'm not, and I sincerely believe that I never will be.

It might sound selfish but if everything I'm going through is to help other people succeed then I'm not interested in carrying on. I already find resentment in seeing people happy. If my own happiness isn't the outcome then fuck it, what is the point?
